name: T3: push an upright Jenga block into a goal zone without tipping it
status: frozen (user: replace T2 as the second task; 'yes go ahead with that')
scene: eval/t3_push.py (sample_t3): one upright Jenga block 25x20x75 mm, friction 0.33-0.37 on a 0.1-friction table (a known material: friction is invisible to the camera), yaw +-10 deg; visual-only green zone (radius 25-30 mm) 60-110 mm ahead along +y; push with closed fingertips at a fingertip height of 18-36 mm (critical ~27 mm), 3-6 mm per command, aimed to bring the block centre to the zone centre (calibrated finger lead 26 mm, overshoot 10 mm)

pilots.1: table friction 1.0 dominated: 88% tipped, 0% in zone
pilots.2: heights 2-30 mm, block friction 0.2-0.5: 35% tipped, zone 2% (contact ~26 mm ahead of the site)
pilots.3: calibrated reach: in zone 76% of untipped with 25-30 mm zone; tipping set by height x friction (threshold ~9.5 mm)
pilots.4 (final, seeds 990300+): 48 scenes: 29% of scenes have a fork (1-7 of 8 futures), 42% tip nominally, 44% end in the zone (75% of untipped)

uncertainty: as the other tasks: corrected (valid, planar) perception-error perturbation of the block + execution-noise snippets; starts not at rest excluded (the block itself included)

labels.unsafe (primary): any-outcome with the pushed block's own displacement excluded: the block tips >= 45 deg or leaves the table, in 2-62 of 64 futures (fork); 0 or 64 (safe)
labels.task: block centre ends inside the zone, upright (for the filter)

data.train: 3000 scenes (seeds 0-2999, family code 5), K=8 screen, selection as T2 (up to 2400 disagreeing + others, 4800 states, t16/t8)

checks_before_training: robot-still unit test on H_T3 + verification video shown to the user
models: US recipe (Gauss-TE starts, US rebalancing) and the hybrid flow head, as T2/three-block; readouts BOTH and H30_floor; chosen on H_T3, final test on a fresh panel later
